title: Privileged access reviews are not consistently documented
description: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) is tightly mapped via AWS IAM Identity Center. Separation between AI Model Training groups and active live SCADA ingestion infrastructure verified via separate IAM boundaries.
evidenceDetails: IAM configuration manifests indicate separate permissions for AI model training and production SCADA environments. Based on the evidence provided, the control appears implemented. Operational effectiveness was not independently tested as part of this assessment.
remediationStrategy:
Maintain the MFA configuration and periodically verify enforcement, exceptions, and 
validity of supporting assurance documentation.
residualRiskRationale: Control was determined to be compliant.

title: Incident response exercise is overdue
description: The described authentication controls are intended to support secure access management and align with the relevant NERC CIP access control objectives. Identity verification mandates FIPS 140-2 validated hardware MFA tokens for all active interactive remote sessions.
evidenceDetails: Okta identity rules enforce biometric-backed hardware keys for all accounts mapped to the cloud grid console.
remediationStrategy:
Maintain the MFA configuration and periodically verify enforcement, exceptions, and 
validity of supporting assurance documentation.
residualRiskRationale: Control was determined to be compliant.

title: Supplier security review records need consolidation
description: While the live cloud SCADA pipelines operate within strict isolation matching NERC CIP-005 requirements, the public API layer servicing the AI predictive consumption engine shares an upstream transit gateway architecture with the corporate development cluster, creating an aggregate perimeter hazard.
remediationStrategy: Review routing and security boundaries, then separate the AI API path from standard corporate development routing where justified. Apply independent inspection and firewall controls; and document any required exceptions.
residualRiskRationale: Following implementation and validation of network segmentation controls, the likelihood of unauthorized lateral movement between environments is significantly reduced. Some risk remains due to potential configuration errors, privileged account compromise, or control bypass.

title: Asset inventory is missing assigned owners
description: The specialized containers the AI workloads run do so without outbound proxy content filtering, presenting a vector for possible command-and-control exploitation.
remediationStrategy: Implement outbound web filtering and restrict egress to approved destinations. Confirm required external data sources, monitor allowed and blocked traffic, and document exceptions.
residualRiskRationale: The environment possesses highly sensitive data and required continued external connectivity. A successful control bypass, misconfiguration, or compromise could result in significant data exposure or exfiltration.

title: Security awareness completion below target
description: Documented and approved incident response procedures specific to incidents affecting cloud-hosted SCADA gateways and AI energy prediction infrastructure were absent. No evidence of incident response exercises or testing was provided.

updates.comment: Updated the finding description to be that of the Incident Response control.
updates.author: Alex Dabbs

remediationStrategy: Approve an incident response plan covering classification, escalation, roles, communications, containment, and recovery. Include scenarios for unauthorized SCADA gateway access, compromised cloud credentials, and suspicious AI workload activity. Run a tabletop exercise and track resulting actions.
residualRiskRationale: Given the sensitivity and criticality of the environment, continued testing and periodic review of incident response procedures are required. Residual risk remains due to the potential for delayed response, human error, or unforeseen incident scenarios.
